title: Neurologist steers Jim toward John Mack and Ray Fowler
place_text: Boston area, Massachusetts (Beth Israel / Harvard Medical School; Marriott hotel conference)

tellings.quote: few days later he came into my room and said look you know this guy named Ray Fowler Raymond Fowler is going to he's a UFO investigator and he's going to be at this um conference

plain: In 1976, while a patient in a Boston hospital connected to Harvard Medical School, a man named Jim Weiner says a neurologist, named in the telling as Jonathan Silverman, came into his room and pointed him toward people who studied UFOs. Weiner tells it as his own story: the doctor told him about Raymond Fowler, a UFO investigator who would be speaking at a conference at a Marriott hotel, and also steered him toward a man named John Mack. He tells it as the moment a medical doctor took his strange experience seriously enough to send him to these researchers.
